dump_mfcc_features: run the script to dump MFCC features from audio files in a TSV shard to a feature directory
read_audio_MfccFeatureReader: use MfccFeatureReader to read an audio file and return the waveform tensor at a given sample rate
get_feats_MfccFeatureReader: call get_feats on MfccFeatureReader to extract MFCC features with deltas and double-deltas from an audio path
main_function: run the main function to iterate over audio paths from a TSV file and dump MFCC features in shards
torchaudio_kaldi_mfcc: use torchaudio compliance kaldi mfcc to compute MFCC features from a waveform tensor with a specified sample frequency
